note: dépenser (active spending) vs économiser (saving) form the core opposition; coûter expresses passive cost. Useful for discussing budgeting.
All involve escape but differ in scale/formality: fuite is general, évasion implies organized/large-scale, fugue implies adolescent/temporary departure.
conviction and croyance are emotionally-charged beliefs; certitude is rational certainty. Conviction emphasizes personal conviction; croyance often implies religious/faith dimension.
détenir carries legal/custody connotations; posséder emphasizes ownership rights; tenir emphasizes physical holding. Context determines usage.
évaluation is objective/systematic; estimation is approximate; jugement is subjective value judgment. Each serves different purposes (testing, numbers, opinions).
innocent (not guilty/naive) vs coupable (guilty) are legal opposites. Culpabilité adds the noun form for guilt/responsibility. Innocent also carries 'naivety' sense.
Agriculture is the overall industry; cultiver applies to plant cultivation and metaphorical development; élever applies specifically to animal husbandry and child-rearing.
doux and dur are everyday opposites with sensory/emotional dimensions; sucré is taste-specific. Doux encompasses touch, taste, and temperament; dur similarly spans domains.
Word family progression: gouverner (action) → gouverneur (person) → gouvernement (institution). Understanding root helps retention.
jouir/jouissance are formal and legal (property/rights), with legal contracts using jouissance; plaisir is pure pleasure. Jouir is polysemous.
traverser emphasizes crossing through one obstacle; parcourir emphasizes covering full distance/scope. Parcourir also used for quickly reading.
augmenter and diminuer are action verbs forming clear opposition; croissant is adjective describing trends. Croissant also means crescent (cognate with English). Easy to confuse pos.
classer is formal/systematic (ranking/filing); trier is practical (sorting by selection); catégorie is the noun (classification itself). Classer implies hierarchy; trier implies choice.
audience emphasizes formal/hearing context or listening; spectateur emphasizes visual witnessing; spectacle is the event. Audience in French is narrower than English.
multiple emphasizes dimensional variety/complexity; nombreux and plusieurs both express quantity but nombreux is adjectival/formal, plusieurs is indefinite pronoun.
Direct opposition: minorité (fewer) vs majorité (more). Majorité also carries legal meaning (age of adulthood). Both nouns; understand dual meaning of majorité.
Time spectrum: provisoire (short-term/uncertain) → définitif (concluded/final) → permanent (endless). Provisoire and définitif contrast temporal boundary; permanent implies no endpoint.
Noun pair: disparition (the fact of disappearing) vs apparition (the fact of appearing); disparaître is the verb form. Apparition carries ghost/supernatural connotation.
dynamique is formal/business context (drive/initiative); énergique emphasizes physical energy/vigor; vif emphasizes liveliness/animation of spirit. Register and focus differ.
renverser implies violent/dramatic reversal; changer is neutral/everyday alteration; transformer implies substantial/fundamental change. Spectrum of intensity.
trouble is most abstract/psychological; confusion emphasizes mistaken mixing; désordre emphasizes physical disorder. Trouble spans emotional, intellectual, and physical meanings.
désoler is literary/emotional; attrister is neutral sadness; déprimer implies clinical depression/psychological state. Intensity and register increase progressively.
accélérer and ralentir are speed opposites; freiner emphasizes braking force/inhibition. Freiner carries metaphorical sense (obstacle/hindrance).
résider is formal/administrative; habiter is everyday living; demeurer is literary and carries 'remain/stay' sense. Demeurer also used in passé composé with être for state-of-being.
dessiner emphasizes line/design structure; peindre emphasizes color/visual representation; esquisser emphasizes rapid initial outline. Media and precision differ.
rompre emphasizes separation/severance (physical and relational); casser emphasizes fragmentation/shattering; détruire emphasizes complete annihilation. Intensity spectrum.
Parallel pair: cultiver for plants/metaphorical development; élever for animals/child-rearing. Linked to agriculture and livestock industries respectively.
armer is military-specific (weaponry); équiper is general equipment; arme is the weapon noun. Armer has narrower scope; équiper applies broadly.
bâtir is traditional/architectural; construire is modern/systematic; édifier carries metaphorical moral/intellectual establishment. Édifier also means to instruct morally.
prime is bonus/extra (discretionary); récompense is reward for merit/achievement; salaire is base compensation. Decreasing discretionary character.
résulter emphasizes passive consequence; produire emphasizes active generation/manufacture; engendrer emphasizes causal chain/origin. Agency spectrum.
Object vs person distinction critical: apporter/emporter for objects; amener/emmener for people. Directional pairs: toward (apporter/amener) vs away (emporter/emmener).
Complementary roles: lecteur (reader) vs auteur (author). Lecteur is polysemous (person reading or optical device). Context determines meaning.
